summary: Iteration 24 — Contract termination (legacy per-contract + whole-client) feature tested end-to-end. Backend termination endpoints work correctly (validation, RBAC/tenant scope, state transitions, persistence, idempotency 409). Frontend: client-terminate-btn / client-term-dialog / legacy-contracts section render with correct JA copy, submit-disabled logic, and proper data-testids. One real backend bug discovered: /api/platform/email-log?kind=termination is silently ignored because mail_log.py KINDS tuple is missing 'termination'.

critical.issue: Filter is silently dropped. `KINDS` in /app/backend/mail_log.py (line 16) is ('invite','econtract','renewal','invoice','refund','inquiry','system','other') — missing 'termination'. The route validates with `if kind in KINDS`, so termination filter never applies and the endpoint returns rows of all kinds. Frontend spec explicitly requires 'termination (契約解除)' in the platform email log kind filter.

issues: Breadcrumb renders 'UNDEFINED › 解約済み' when the client has no legal_form/type. Fallback label should be i18n'd (e.g., '—') instead of literal 'UNDEFINED'. Reproduced on newly-created test client TEST_Termination_2_KK after termination.

action_items: Add 'termination' to KINDS in /app/backend/mail_log.py (line 16) so the platform email-log kind filter can filter termination emails.
In ClientDetail breadcrumb / status area, replace the literal 'UNDEFINED' when a client has no legal_form/type.
critical_code_review_comments: termination.py `_client` calls `scope(user, cid)` then does another `db.clients.find_one` — redundant DB read; `scope` could already return the client doc.
termination.py stores background asyncio tasks in module-level `_BG` set. It works but under load could accumulate; consider tying tasks to app lifecycle.

sign_notify.py `_deliver` maps kind→'termination' inline (`{'contract_ended': 'termination'}`) — this mapping only exists here while mail_log.KINDS whitelist is defined elsewhere. Both places must agree; keep the vocabulary in a single constants module.

rca of the issue: File /app/backend/mail_log.py line 16 defines KINDS = ('invite','econtract','renewal','invoice','refund','inquiry','system','other'). The route at line 94 uses `if kind in KINDS: f['kind']=kind`. sign_notify._deliver maps 'contract_ended' → 'termination' when calling send_email, so db.email_log ends up with kind='termination' (correct). But when the frontend passes kind=termination to /api/platform/email-log, the guard rejects it and the filter is discarded, so the UI can never show a termination-only list. Fix: add 'termination' to KINDS.
